entries.label: 2nd Billion Dollar Grant
cells: Bolaia now get a brilliant +20% Study Rate per LV, instead of the previous +15% per LV!

entries.label: 2nd Bucket!
cells: Adds another bucket at the Well! You'll need to expand your Gravel bar to hold the 130 needed to create this!

entries.label: 3rd Bucket!
cells: Adds another bucket at the Well! Remember, click a bucket to change what sediment it collects! That's how you get this gold resource!

entries.label: 4th Bucket!
cells: Adds yet another bucket at the Well!

entries.label: 6th Bucket!
cells: Adds another bucket at the Well! I guess 5 wasn't enough for a go getter like yourself!

entries.label: 7rth Barckot?!
cells: Adds another bucket at the Well! You DO want more buckets, right?

entries.label: 9th Bucket!
cells: Adds another bucket at the Well! Yea apparently there were a few more of these left!

entries.label: Advanced Collection
cells: You can now find new collectible types from jars, found in the new 2nd page of your collection! Go collect 'em all!

entries.label: All This Ringing in my Ears
cells: When Ringing the Bell, there is now a 25% chance to get 2x more LVs than you otherwise would have gotten!

entries.label: Amplifier Stackin'
cells: You now get an additional +0.50x Multiplier at the Dawg Den for every 10 total charge across all amplifiers!

entries.label: Anotha One
cells: Gives you a 2nd Golden Bucket, which fills faster as described by the 'Golden Bucket Boost' upgrade at Cavern 16's Fountain

entries.label: Aye String
cells: Permanently unlocks a new String Type for the Harp! You can level it up just like any other string!

entries.label: Bar Expand-o-rama
cells: Adds the 'Expand Full Bars' toggle to the Well! Let me explain... when a bar is full of sediment, you lose half of the sediment, but permanently increase the max by 1.50x!

entries.label: Better Buckets
cells: Increases the base fill rate of all Well Buckets from 10/hr to 15/hr. IMPORTANT:You can click on the buckets for more info!

entries.label: Big Jar Mach II
cells: Upgrades the main jar, doubling the base value of every rupie you find. So if you see 2 red rupies, you actually got 4!

entries.label: Big Jar Mach III
cells: Upgrades the main jar, allowing you to produce 2 jar types at once!

entries.label: Big Jar Mach IV
cells: Upgrades the main jar, increasing the chance for multiple rupies in a jar by +50%

entries.label: Big Jar Mach V
cells: Upgrades the main jar, doubling the base value of every rupie you find AGAIN! If 2 red rupies gave you 4 before, now it's 8!!!

entries.label: Big Jar Mach VI
cells: Upgrades the main jar, allowing you to produce 3 jar types at once!

entries.label: Big Jar Mach VII
cells: Upgrades the main jar, reducing the production amount required to make jars by 30% so you can make them faster!

entries.label: Big Jar Mach VIII
cells: Upgrades the main jar, doubling the base value of every rupie you find! This does not stack with the other ones... just kidding it totally does! ANOTHER 2x RUPIES!!!

entries.label: Billion Dollar Grant
cells: Bolaia now get a sumptuous +15% Study Rate per LV, instead of the previous +10% per LV!

entries.label: Bishop Gambit
cells: Unlocks the Bishop challenge in the Gambit cavern.

entries.label: Break All Button
cells: Adds a new button to the top left of the Jar, allowing you to break all jars at once!

entries.label: Bucket Finale!
cells: Adds another bucket at the Well! And yea this one is actually the last one, I don't think an 11th would fit on screen!

entries.label: Castle Gambit
cells: Unlocks the Castle challenge in the Gambit cavern.

entries.label: Cavern 'Porting
cells: All teleports to this map are free! Also, did you know you can double-click a map instead of pressing the Teleport button?

entries.label: Collect 'Em All
cells: Gives a 1.02x chance to find a new collectible for every digit of all the rupies you own.

entries.label: Compound Interest
cells: You start with +1 more Court Coins every Power of 2 HRs of AFK time at the Justice Monument! So 2Hrs you get +1 coin, 4Hrs you get +2 coins, 8Hrs you get +3 coins, and so on!

entries.label: Cutting Edge Research
cells: Bolaia now get a massive +10% Study Rate per LV, instead of the previous +7% per LV!

entries.label: Cyan Amplifier
cells: Adds a new Amplifier stone to interact with at the Dawg Den!

entries.label: Dark Amplifier
cells: Adds a new Amplifier stone to interact with at the Dawg Den!

entries.label: Dark Luck
cells: Every POW 10 dark rupies you own increases the chance of enchanting collectibles from the Enchanted Jar by 1.10x

entries.label: DNA Rock Tumbler
cells: Gives you a +60% chance to get an additional Grey Gene when trashing a Mob for every Power of 10 Gravel you have.

entries.label: Domino Effect
cells: Strings give +20% more per string plucked during a strum... let me explain. Imagine you have 5 strings, this would mean the final string you pluck would be worth DOUBLE!

entries.label: Double Dinger Ringer
cells: Ringing the Bell now has a +30% chance of giving +2 LV to a bonus, instead of just +1 LV

entries.label: Eee String
cells: Permanently unlocks a new String Type for the Harp! You can level it up by plucking it, getting +1 EXP per 100% Harp Power!

entries.label: Eff String
cells: Permanently unlocks a new String Type for the Harp! You can level it up by plucking it, getting +1 EXP per 100% Harp Power!

entries.label: Even Better Buckets
cells: Increases the base fill rate of all Well Buckets from 15/hr to 20/hr. Try changing your bucket to remove the rocks, once you remove that layer you can collect gold dust!

entries.label: Even More Goo
cells: Boosts your Double Shape chance from 10% up to 20%

entries.label: Evertree ~ Rupie Synergy
cells: Boosts overall Rupie value by 1.10x per Evertree Trunk you've whittled!

entries.label: Evertree Trickledown
cells: +15% All Skill Efficiency, and +10% All Skill EXP gain per Evertree Trunk you've whittled!

entries.label: Expander Extravaganza
cells: Gives all your buckets +20% Fill Rate per bar expansion across all sediment types! This includes Uber expansions later!

entries.label: Final Ballad of the Snail
cells: Gives you a 1.04x higher success chance when leveling up Snail for every Power of 10 Trebel Notes you have.

entries.label: First Try, I swear!
cells: If you throw the LAST bravery sword first, and it kills the monster, you get a +10% Sword Max DMG bonus for the rest of the story. If it doesn't kill, this bonus resets back to 0%

entries.label: Five Nights at Bucket
cells: Adds one more bucket at the Well! Five buckets!!! WOW! That's worth writing home about!

entries.label: Fractalfly ~ Harp Synergy
cells: Boosts your Harp Note production by 1.10x per Undying Hive Layer you've destroyed!

entries.label: Fractalfly Trickledown
cells: +15% All Skill Efficiency, and +10% All Skill EXP gain per Undying Hive Layer you've destroyed!

entries.label: Geez String
cells: Permanently unlocks a new String Type for the Harp! You can level it up just like any other string, getting +1 EXP per 100% Harp Power!

entries.label: Gloomie Expie
cells: +25% Class EXP gain for each Colony of Gloomie Mushrooms defeated!

entries.label: Gloomie Lootie
cells: +5% Drop Rate for each Colony of Gloomie Mushrooms defeated! Drop rate here as in like, the one for stuff outside of the Caverns.

entries.label: Gloomie Mulch
cells: Gloomie mushrooms respawn +10% faster! In fact, ALL monsters across all the worlds of IdleOn respawn +10% faster!

entries.label: Gloomie Opie
cells: +10% Villager EXP gain for each Colony of Gloomie Mushrooms successfully romanced... or defeated, whichever is higher.

entries.label: Glunko Conglomeration
cells: Crystal Glunko monsters in Cavern 18 now respawn 25% faster!

entries.label: Green Amplifier
cells: Adds a new Amplifier stone to interact with at the Dawg Den!

entries.label: Heavy Redstone Seasoning
cells: Gives you a multiplicative 1.30x Cooking Speed bonus for every Power of 10 Redstone you have.

entries.label: Hefty Harp
cells: Adds +1 more string to the Harp, it even makes sound when strummed! The other ones do too, but like, this one does too! Just incase you were worried it wouldn't.

entries.label: Hiring the Hounds from Beyond
cells: Gives +10 B.F.R. per 100 hounds defeated in best runs of each class.

entries.label: Horsey Gambit
cells: Unlocks the Horsey challenge in the Gambit cavern.

entries.label: Improvement Stackin'
cells: For every 25 LVs across all Improvement Methods upgrades at the Bell, all your Improvement Method bonuses are 1.10x higher!

entries.label: Increasingly More Goo
cells: Boosts your Double Shape chance from 20% up to 30%

entries.label: Jar Production Line
cells: The requirement to make a jar is 5% lower per POW 10 jars made of the previous type. For example, making 100 Simple Jars would mean Tall jars are 10% quicker to make!

entries.label: Justin Opal
cells: Its 'just an' Opal. A single opal.

entries.label: Last Bucket!
cells: Adds another bucket at the Well! And it's the last one too, I hope your bucket lust is satiated!

entries.label: Light Speed
cells: Every POW 10 white rupies you own increases the production rate of jars by +10%

entries.label: Loaded Harp
cells: Adds +1 more string to the Harp, ready to be strummed until the end of (the) time (signature)!

entries.label: Loadin' some 'Lode
cells: Gives +5 Bucket Fill Rate per Power of 10 Motherlode Ore mined.

entries.label: Max Monument Rewards
cells: Monument Reward Multi now increases at the normal rate of +100% daily for 4 full days! Before this upgrade, it was only 2 days...

entries.label: Monument Mogmaxing
cells: Monument Reward Multi now increases at the normal rate of +100% daily for 6 full days! Before this upgrade, it was only 4 days...

entries.label: More Goo
cells: Whenever you pick up shapes dropped by Crystal Glunko monsters, there's a 10% chance to get DOUBLE the amount!

entries.label: Motherlode ~ Bucket Synergy
cells: Gives all your buckets 1.10x fill rate per Motherlode Layer you've destroyed!

entries.label: Motherlode Trickledown
cells: +15% All Skill Efficiency, and +10% All Skill EXP gain per Motherlode Layer you've destroyed!

entries.label: Multitudinal Harp
cells: Adds +9999 more strings to the Harp! Haha nah just +1 string, figured I'd keep you on your toes! If I tricked you, you must go pluck the F string.

entries.label: Noise Reduction Therapy
cells: Gives you a multiplicative 1.20x Stealth bonus for all ninjas for every Power of 10 Quaver Notes you have.

entries.label: Noob Gambit
cells: Unlocks the Noob challenge in the Gambit cavern.

entries.label: Opal Dividends
cells: Each opal invested in a villager now gives them 125 EXP/hr, instead of 100 EXP/hr. Also worry not, you can reset your opals later at Cavern 7

entries.label: Packed Harp
cells: Adds +1 more string to the Harp, you'll find it right next to all your other strings!

entries.label: Peer Reviewed Books
cells: Bolaia now get +7% Study Rate per LV, instead of the previous +5% per LV!

entries.label: Pink Amplifier
cells: Adds a new Amplifier stone to interact with at the Dawg Den!

entries.label: Purple Amplifier
cells: Adds a new Amplifier stone to interact with at the Dawg Den!

entries.label: Queen Gambit
cells: Unlocks the Queen challenge in the Gambit cavern.

entries.label: Reroll Keeper
cells: Each unused reroll you have in a Bravery Story gives +10% Sword Max DMG. So don't be all loosey goosey with those rerolls!

entries.label: Rift Guy
cells: Hey bet you weren't expecting to see me here, huh? Well, that's just how it goes with me, it's in my blood. It's how I roll. Go ahead, create me. Or don't, I'll keep being me.

entries.label: RNG Oxidizing Layer
cells: When you Clean the Bell and FAIL to get a new Improvement Method, the success chance for next time goes up by 1.25x. This happens every fail, and resets when you finally succeed!

entries.label: Roaring Flame
cells: +25% chance to get DOUBLE the Torches from Ancient Golems when picking them up!

entries.label: Rock Smart
cells: After much thought, this schematic has decided to give +20% Monument AFK gain, and +2 Starting Attempts for the Wisdom Story per POW 10 Wisdom Monument Hours.

entries.label: Sanctum of DMG
cells: +100% Total Damage for each Sanctum of Ancient Golems you've cleared!

entries.label: Sanctum of EXP
cells: +40% Class EXP for each Sanctum of Ancient Golems you've cleared!

entries.label: Sanctum of LOOT
cells: +20% Drop Rate for each Sanctum of Ancient Golems you've cleared!

entries.label: Size DOES Matter
cells: When collecting a coinstack at The Fountain, you get +10% MULTI per stack height. Example:If a stack was 5 coins high, they'd all be worth 1.50x more!!!

entries.label: Stringy Effect
cells: Strings give +15% more. More what, you ask? More everything! They give more String EXP, more notes, higher chance for opal... so yea, MORE!

entries.label: Sumptuous Harp
cells: Adds +1 more string to the Harp... all these strings really remind me of string cheese, I used to love it!

entries.label: Supergiant Jars
cells: Jars now COMBINE to save space! 10 Jars becomes 1 large jar, which gives 10x rewards. 10 large jars become 1 giant jar, which gives 100x rewards. This continues forever!

entries.label: The Sicilian
cells: +10% Total Gambit Score

entries.label: The Story Changes Over Time...
cells: Bravery Swords get +1 minimum DMG and +10 maximum DMG per 6 HR of AFK time at the Bravery Monument!

entries.label: Trench ~ Coin Synergy
cells: Boosts the value of all coin types, also called Currencies, by 1.10x per Trench Depth you've cast!

entries.label: Trench Trickledown
cells: +15% All Skill Efficiency, and +10% All Skill EXP gain per Bottomless Trench Depth you've cast down to!

entries.label: Triple Decker Extender
cells: All coinstacks at The Fountain can stack +3 coins higher than before!

entries.label: Triple Tap Tinkle
cells: Ringing the Bell now has another +30% chance of giving +2 LV to a bonus instead of just +1 LV. Also, there's a new +20% chance of giving +3 LV instead of +2 or +1!

entries.label: True Golden Edge
cells: Gives all your players +20% Damage for every Power of 10 Golddust you have.

entries.label: Tune of Artifaction
cells: Gives you +10% Artifact Find Chance for every Power of 10 Natural Notes you have.

entries.label: UBER Bar Expand-o-rama-hala
cells: Allow for UBER Full Bar Expansion, which means you can expand Well Bars beyond the previous limit of 14 times.

entries.label: Variety Effect
cells: Strings give +30% more for each unique string type on your harp...

entries.label: White Amplifier
cells: Adds a new Amplifier stone to interact with at the Dawg Den!

entries.label: Yellow Amplifier
cells: Adds a new Amplifier stone to interact with at the Dawg Den!

pageProps.seoDescription: Every one of the 105 engineer schematics in Legends of Idleon, and what each one connects to.
